# Aspect Ratio Calculator

> Calculate image, video and ultrawide aspect ratios and pixel dimensions. Free browser-based tools maintained by wherexml.

## Tools
- [Aspect ratio calculator](https://imageaspectratio.com/): Calculate a missing dimension, reduce width and height to a ratio, or scale dimensions.
- [Image aspect ratio](https://imageaspectratio.com/image-aspect-ratio): Read dimensions from a local image and preview Fit/Fill.
- [Video aspect ratio](https://imageaspectratio.com/video-aspect-ratio): Enter dimensions to compare frame fit; assumes square pixels.
- [Ultrawide calculator](https://imageaspectratio.com/ultrawide-aspect-ratio-calculator): Distinguish exact pixel ratios from the 21:9 category.

## About and support
- [About](https://imageaspectratio.com/about): Calculation methods, scope and maintainer.
- [Contact](https://imageaspectratio.com/contact): Public GitHub issue tracker.
- [Privacy](https://imageaspectratio.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://imageaspectratio.com/terms)
- [Source code](https://github.com/wherexml/aspectratio): MIT license.

## Limitations
Calculations use exact fractions; rounded pixel values are labeled. Fit/Fill are previews. The tool does not resize, crop, export or transcode files. Selected images are read locally in the browser. Open-source availability and indexability do not imply search engine ranking or endorsement.
